items.title: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
items.summary: Ex-minister Alan Milburn has set out plans to divert spending from benefits towards job support.

items.title: Police in Philippines pursue three charges against Thomas Markle Sr
items.summary: Filipino police are pursuing three charges against Thomas Markle Sr relating to child sexual abuse images, Sky News understands.

items.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai
items.summary: The Prince and Princess of Wales were joined by sporting and acting stars for the annual environmental awards ceremony.

items.title: Jensen Huang says he'd be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: Jensen Huang has acknowledged "serious mistakes" in his first statement since resigning as CEO of Nvidia, but says he would be honoured to return to his role.

items.title: Channel 4 admits it doesn't know number of Married At First Sight UK sex abuse complaints
items.summary: C4's chief executive is questioned by MPs after a string of allegations were made about the show.

items.title: American soldier arrested in UK by counter terror police taken into US custody
items.summary: A US soldier arrested by counter terror police in the UK has been taken into custody by the American military.
